description: Sudan - Floods and Drought Hazards is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Sudan. This file contains the the Sudan admin2 level localities with data of the climate hazards in the country (flood affected by year and overall risk/severity and drought risk/severity. Coverage: Sudan. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Sudan. Its tags are climate-weather, drought, flooding, hazards and risk. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-05-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
